Subject: Vendor onboarding invite expired / can’t complete registration

Hi Vanessa,

We tried to finish the supplier registration you sent yesterday but the invite link says it has expired. When we click to request a new invite, the registration form rejects our EIN in the "Tax ID / VAT" field with a validation error (screenshot attached). We attempted with and without dashes; same result. Because our account is not active we can’t upload the W-9 or accept the PO through the portal, which is blocking our finance team.

Can you either extend the invite or provision a temporary account so we can complete the paperwork? If not, we need the PO issued and a manual onboarding path so we can start the contract.

Hi Emma — thanks for the heads up and sorry for the friction.

Quick plan: I’ve attached our onboarding checklist which lists the exact fields we need from your side (redwood_onboarding_checklist.xlsx). Two immediate options:
1) I can ask infra to reissue a fresh invite with an extended expiration (24h) — should fix the expired-link path.
2) If the portal validation is blocking EIN formats, we can temporarily provision a "provisional" vendor account on the backend so you can upload the W-9 and accept the PO; we’ll migrate any portal data once the portal accepts the file.

Aditya — can you confirm whether we’re OK to do a provisional activation for Acme (will require a note in HubSpot and a one-off manual PO flow)? Laura — can finance/legal sign off on receiving PO via manual route if necessary?

If you can send the W-9 directly to me (or upload once provisioned) that’ll speed things up.

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding invite expired / can’t complete registration

I can provision a provisional vendor record in our procurement backend (will be flagged as "provisional_onboard") so Acme can upload docs and accept the PO. I just need the following from the vendor: legal business name, EIN, and the signed W-9 (PDF). Once I have those I can:

- Create provisional vendor record in VendorDB (internal id: prov-ACME-0042)
- Upload the W-9 and set visibility to finance-only for the initial intake
- Trigger a manual PO issuance so your procurement team can acknowledge and proceed

Note on the portal validation: engineering found that the registration form enforces a strict regex on the "Tax ID / VAT" field that fails when the EIN is submitted with leading zeros or with a dash pattern different from NN-NNNNNNN. We’ve logged a bug (SUP-2319) and will patch next sprint, but for now use one of two workarounds: submit the EIN as eight digits (drop leading zero) OR submit without dashes. Either should let the portal accept the record. I will still provision the provisional account so nothing blocks.
